assumptions: Human-answered fork: extend the layer model (option 1), not record agents/skills as out of scope.

A second layer `skills` over agents/skills/claude-code/** was added alongside `skills-lib`: harness check-deps only judges an import edge when both ends resolve to a layer, so the lib -> skills direction rule is unenforceable without it.
Per-root module counts are printed and asserted by the denominator test (reportVerified 'arch-scope'); harness check-deps itself only prints a total, which is upstream output canary does not own.
check-phase-gate is a step inside the required `validate` job, not a required status context, so removing it does not touch .github/required-checks.json and did not require parking.
Removal covers both surfaces that reported it: the direct step in harness-quality.yml and the phase-gate entry inside `harness ci check` (now --skip phase-gate).
Generated harness agent docs (agents/agents/*/harness-verifier.md) that mention check-phase-gate were left untouched: they are harness-generated, not canary's gate list.
